protocol.task: retrospective same-hour traffic estimation with observed weather; not advance forecasting
protocol.training: all retained timestamps strictly before each validation start
protocol.timestamp_semantics: naive local clock; whole-hour grid; no timezone or DST inference
protocol.seasonal_lag: exact same-clock-time seven calendar days earlier from training only
protocol.seasonal_fallback: training weekday/hour mean, then training global mean
protocol.paired_mae_sign: random_forest minus baseline; negative favors forest on the same cohort
protocol.limitations: four development weeks, not annual performance; no significance or operational availability claim
